title: Who Gets Cited? Gender- and Majority-Bias in LLM-Driven Reference Selection

bias_targets.methodology: Controlled name substitution in reference lists, replacing real author names with distinctly male or female pseudonyms to isolate and measure differences in LLM selection rates.

Systematically varying the composition and proportion of different groups (male vs. female authors) within candidate reference pools to evaluate if models disproportionately favor whichever group is most prevalent.
